_meta.description: Key milestones of Line 6, oldest first. 'date_precision' is day, month or year. 'kind' is planning, approval, tender, award, construction, related or future. Only events whose source was read are listed.

events.title: DMRC prepares the project report
events.summary: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation prepares the detailed project report for MMRDA.

events.title: State Cabinet approves Line 6
events.summary: The Maharashtra government approves Metro Line 6, Swami Samarth Nagar to Vikhroli.

events.title: First civil package, Swami Samarth Nagar to Shyam Nagar
events.summary: Package BC-03, 6.079 km of viaduct with five stations, goes to J Kumar Infraprojects.

events.title: Civil package, Mahakali Caves to Powai Lake
events.summary: Package BC-02R, five stations, to MBZ-EIIL JV for Rs 372.22 crore, to be done in 30 months.

events.title: Civil package, IIT Powai to Vikhroli
events.summary: Package BC-01R1, 4.771 km of viaduct with three stations and the ramp to the depot, to J Kumar Infraprojects for Rs 444.98 crore.

events.title: First U girder on the line
events.summary: J Kumar erects the first U girder on package BC-03.

events.title: Collector hands the Kanjurmarg depot land to MMRDA
events.summary: The Mumbai suburban collector transfers about 15 ha to MMRDA; the Centre's salt department challenges the decision in court.

events.title: First train tender cancelled
events.summary: MMRDA cancels tender CA-130 for 108 standard gauge cars for Line 6. The trains are re-tendered with the signalling in one package, CA-232.

events.title: Kanjurmarg depot contract to Sam India
events.summary: MMRDA issues a letter of acceptance for package CA-209, the depot and staff quarters, for Rs 547.45 crore. Work waits for the land.

events.title: High Court orders status quo on the depot land
events.summary: The Bombay High Court orders that the status quo be kept on the Kanjurmarg land.

events.title: Station finishing for all 13 stations begins
events.summary: Three packages, CA-264, CA-265 and CA-266, for Rs 367.02 crore in all, with notice to proceed on 1 Feb 2025 and 24 months each.

events.title: Trains and signalling to NCC
events.summary: NCC receives the letter of acceptance for package CA-232: trains, CBTC signalling, telecom, platform screen doors and depot machinery, about Rs 2,269 crore without GST.

events.title: Power and E&M to IRCON
events.summary: IRCON receives the letter of acceptance for package CA-233: power supply, traction, E&M, lifts and escalators, Rs 642.44 crore.

events.title: NCC orders the trains from Titagarh
events.summary: Titagarh Rail Systems announces a Rs 1,598.55 crore order from NCC for 18 six-car trains, 108 coaches (PTI).

events.title: MMRDA plans to open without the depot
events.summary: An elevated corridor with pit lines beside the Eastern Express Highway is under construction, so trains can be serviced before the Kanjurmarg depot is built.

events.title: Footbridge tender for Vikhroli and Jogeshwari stations
events.summary: MMRDA floats a tender for foot over bridges at the Vikhroli and Jogeshwari Line 6 stations; bids close on 12 Nov 2026.

events.title: Reported target: the line opens
events.summary: Lokshahi (Aug 2026): MMRDA aims to run Metro 6 by 2027. MMRDA has announced no date.
